answer: Fire a simultaneous burst: at one random second each epoch, every agent gets its own prism of five puzzles needing about eight GPU-seconds, due back within twelve seconds. An honest agent on its own hardware finishes easily. A Sybil orchard of 300 keys sharing one rented card must solve 300 bursts at once, so most miss the window and forfeit that epoch's pay. To keep each fake alive the attacker must buy real parallel compute per key, so the farm costs as much as the marble-solid honest agents it imitates.
